versions.content: If the silence - after - wakeup timer is running and the ComM requests COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION , the LinSM shall delay the call of LinIf_Wakeup until the silence - after - wakeup timer has timed out. ( see also SWS_LinSM_00047 )
